title: Speaking — Practising a hobby
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on practising a hobby.

questions: Where do you usually go if you need to study or read?
Do you prefer to learn in the morning or evening?
How do you keep track of what you have learned?
What helps you get back to studying after a break?
What hobby would you like to spend more time on?
Do you normally practise alone or with other people?

part2.topic: Describe a hobby you returned to after a long break.
points: what brought you back to it
part2.closing: and explain how your approach has changed.

questions: Why do people abandon hobbies they previously enjoyed?
How can community organisations make hobbies affordable for beginners?
How has everyday life connected with practising a hobby changed for people of different ages?
